translations.literal: There was also a widow with only one son who likewise sued him for unfilial conduct. Yuhuan kept the son at the prefectural hall, provided daily meals, and had the mother feed him in person with morning and evening courtesy. Before a month had passed, mother and son were as before.
translations.idiomatic: There was also a widow with only one son who sued him for unfilial conduct. Yuhuan kept the son at the prefectural hall, provided daily meals, and had the mother feed him in person with morning and evening courtesy. Before a month had passed, mother and son were reconciled.

sentences.zh: 二家皆畫像事之。

translations.literal: Both families painted portraits and served them in worship.
translations.idiomatic: Both families painted portraits and honored them in worship.

sentences.zh: 喪母，朝廷屢起之，不可，議使守邊，授淮西提點刑獄，弗能奪。

translations.literal: After his mother's death the court repeatedly recalled him, but he would not accept. It was proposed that he guard the frontier, and he was appointed Judicial Intendant of Huai West, but this could not be changed.
translations.idiomatic: After his mother's death the court repeatedly recalled him, but he refused. When it was proposed that he guard the frontier and he was appointed Judicial Intendant of Huai West, he could not be persuaded to accept.

sentences.zh: 再期，以刑部郎官召，乞終禫，奉祠，復半載，乃趨朝。

translations.literal: After another period he was summoned as a secretary in the Ministry of Justice. He begged to complete the final mourning rites, was granted a sinecure, and after half a year more at last went to court.
translations.idiomatic: After another period he was summoned as a secretary in the Ministry of Justice. He begged to complete the final mourning rites, was granted a sinecure, and after half a year more at last returned to court.

sentences.zh: 自恢復退師，又議納使，與歡言：“在朝迎合，政出多門，必得智識氣節之士，布列中外可也。

translations.literal: After the recovery campaign and withdrawal of troops, envoys for peace were again discussed. Yuhuan said: 'At court there is flattery; policy issues from many gates. We must have men of wisdom, knowledge, and integrity deployed throughout the realm.'
translations.idiomatic: After the recovery campaign and withdrawal of troops, envoys for peace were again discussed. Yuhuan said, "At court there is flattery and policy issues from too many hands. We must have men of wisdom, knowledge, and integrity deployed throughout the realm."

sentences.zh: ”兼權檢正，遷宗正少卿兼權戶部侍郎，尋兼知臨安府、浙西安撫使，同詳定，剖決明暢，罪者鹹服。

translations.literal: He was given concurrent acting appointment as Investigating Censor, promoted to Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court with concurrent acting appointment as Vice Minister of Revenue, and soon concurrently governed Lin'an Prefecture and served as Pacification Commissioner of Zhexi. In joint review his judgments were clear and lucid, and the guilty all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: He was given concurrent acting appointment as Investigating Censor, promoted to Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court with concurrent acting appointment as Vice Minister of Revenue, and soon concurrently governed Lin'an Prefecture and served as Pacification Commissioner of Zhexi. In joint review his judgments were clear and lucid, and the guilty all submitted.

sentences.zh: 郊祀之夕，大風雷，與歡言國本未定，又陣弭盜固本之策。

translations.literal: On the eve of the suburban sacrifice there were great wind and thunder. Yuhuan spoke of the unsettled succession and also laid out a strategy to suppress bandits and strengthen the foundation.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve of the suburban sacrifice there were great wind and thunder. Yuhuan spoke of the unsettled succession and laid out a strategy to suppress bandits and strengthen the foundation.

sentences.zh: 有以刑罰術數言於帝者，與歡言：“導民有本。

translations.literal: Some spoke to the emperor of punishments and numerological arts. Yuhuan said: 'Guiding the people has a root.'
translations.idiomatic: Some spoke to the emperor of punishments and numerological arts. Yuhuan said, "Guiding the people has a proper foundation."

sentences.zh: 如臣待罪天府，豈遽能及民，惟其真實相孚，待以不擾，數月而庭訟彌寡。

translations.literal: As for your servant, bearing guilt in the Heavenly Prefecture, how could I quickly reach the people? Only through sincerity and mutual trust, treating them without disturbance, within months court cases grew ever fewer.
translations.idiomatic: As for me, serving in the Heavenly Prefecture, how could I quickly reach the people? Only through sincerity and mutual trust, treating them without disturbance, within months court cases grew ever fewer.

sentences.zh: 人心本善，有感必從。

translations.literal: The human heart is originally good; when moved it must follow.
translations.idiomatic: The human heart is originally good; when moved it will respond.

sentences.zh: 或謂厲以威、待以術者，非知本之論。

translations.literal: Those who say to govern by severity and treat by artifice do not understand the root.
translations.idiomatic: Those who say to govern by severity and treat by artifice do not understand the root of the matter.

sentences.zh: ”且言：“朝令夕改，非以示作新；

translations.literal: He also said: 'Orders changed morning and evening do not show renewal;
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Orders changed morning and evening do not show renewal;

sentences.zh: 旁蹊曲徑，非以肅紀綱。

translations.literal: side paths and crooked ways do not enforce discipline and law.'
translations.idiomatic: side paths and crooked ways do not enforce discipline and law."

sentences.zh: ”帝為悚然。

translations.literal: The emperor was startled.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was startled.

sentences.zh: 又建言：“秦刻頌有‘端平法度’語。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: 'The Qin inscription of praise contains the phrase "Duanping law and measure."'
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized, "The Qin inscription of praise contains the phrase 'Duanping law and measure.'"

sentences.zh: 明年改元嘉熙，襄、蜀殘破，或望風棄地，召見便殿，言：“韓琦當仁宗朝，猶晝夜泣血。

translations.literal: The next year the reign title was changed to Jiaxi. Xiang and Shu were ravaged and broken; some abandoned territory at the mere report of enemy approach. Summoned to the side hall, he said: 'Han Qi in Emperor Renzong's reign still wept blood day and night.'
translations.idiomatic: The next year the reign title was changed to Jiaxi. Xiang and Shu were ravaged; some abandoned territory at the mere report of enemy approach. Summoned to the side hall, he said, "Han Qi in Emperor Renzong's reign still wept blood day and night."

sentences.zh: 今主憂臣辱矣。

translations.literal: Now the sovereign grieves and ministers are shamed.'
translations.idiomatic: Now the sovereign grieves and ministers are shamed."

sentences.zh: ”因具言防邊之道，其後多見施行。

translations.literal: He thereupon fully explained the way to defend the frontier, and much of it was later put into practice.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon fully explained the way to defend the frontier, and much of it was later put into practice.

sentences.zh: 與歡招刺三千人為忠毅軍，又言：“禁衛虛籍及京口諸郡，悉宜募兵，統以郡將，財先贍軍，餘始上供，乞省不急之費。

translations.literal: Yuhuan recruited three thousand men as the Loyal and Resolute Army. He also said: 'The palace guard has empty rolls, and the prefectures around Jingkou should all recruit troops, commanded by prefectural generals. Funds should first support the army, and only the remainder be sent up. I beg that non-urgent expenditures be reduced.'
translations.idiomatic: Yuhuan recruited three thousand men as the Loyal and Resolute Army. He also said, "The palace guard has empty rolls, and the prefectures around Jingkou should all recruit troops under prefectural generals. Funds should first support the army, and only the remainder be sent up. I beg that non-urgent expenditures be reduced."

sentences.zh: ”薦文武士四十人。

translations.literal: He recommended forty civil and military men.
translations.idiomatic: He recommended forty civil and military men.

sentences.zh: 遷戶部侍郎兼權兵部尚書，論邊事至為深切。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue with concurrent acting appointment as Minister of War. His discussion of border affairs was extremely earnest.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue with concurrent acting appointment as Minister of War. His discussion of border affairs was extremely earnest.

sentences.zh: 星變，上章請罷。

translations.literal: When stars changed he submitted a memorial requesting dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: When stars changed he submitted a memorial requesting dismissal.

sentences.zh: 大火，力言災變之烈，謂：“臣罪擢發莫數，猶欲以去國為言，少悟上聽。

translations.literal: When a great fire occurred he forcefully spoke of the severity of the calamity, saying: 'Your servant's crimes are more than can be counted even hair by hair, yet I still wish to speak of leaving office to awaken Your Majesty's hearing somewhat.'
translations.idiomatic: When a great fire occurred he forcefully spoke of the severity of the calamity, saying, "My crimes are beyond counting, yet I still wish to speak of leaving office to awaken Your Majesty somewhat."

sentences.zh: 願祗畏天威，思以實德及民，始自上躬，痛加節約，廣推振恤。

translations.literal: I wish reverently to fear Heaven's majesty, think to reach the people with real virtue, beginning from Your Majesty's own person, strictly practice economy, and broadly extend relief.
translations.idiomatic: I wish reverently to fear Heaven's majesty, reach the people with real virtue, beginning from Your Majesty's own person, strictly practice economy, and broadly extend relief.

sentences.zh: ”五請竄。

translations.literal: He five times requested banishment.
translations.idiomatic: He five times requested banishment.

sentences.zh: 於是中書方大琮言：“與歡素自潔修，疏財輕爵，人所共知，不幸遇此，觀其待罪之章，懇切至到，未嚐不歎其知義也。

translations.literal: Thereupon Vice Administrator Fang Dacong said: 'Yuhuan has always kept himself pure, was sparing with wealth and light toward rank—this all know. Unhappily encountering this, reading his memorial accepting guilt, earnest and thorough, one cannot but sigh at his understanding of righteousness.'
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Vice Administrator Fang Dacong said, "Yuhuan has always kept himself pure, was sparing with wealth and light toward rank—this all know. Unhappily encountering this calamity, reading his memorial accepting guilt, earnest and thorough, one cannot but admire his understanding of righteousness."

sentences.zh: 乞俞所請，使小大之臣，皆知引咎。

translations.literal: I beg that his request be granted, so that ministers great and small all know to accept blame.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that his request be granted, so that ministers great and small all know to accept blame.

sentences.zh: ”乃收一階。

translations.literal: He was therefore demoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: He was therefore demoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 尋復之。

translations.literal: Soon he was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was restored.

sentences.zh: 與歡請先敘復同降官屬，又言：“艱難不可為之時，當慷慨厲誌，深為人才兵力思。

translations.literal: Yuhuan requested that subordinates demoted together be restored first. He also said: 'In times when difficulty makes action impossible, one should be resolute in spirit and think deeply about talent and military strength.'
translations.idiomatic: Yuhuan requested that subordinates demoted together be restored first. He also said, "In times when difficulty makes action impossible, one should be resolute in spirit and think deeply about talent and military strength."

sentences.zh: ”遷戶部尚書兼權吏部，累丐祠，不許。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Minister of Revenue with concurrent acting appointment in the Ministry of Personnel. He repeatedly begged for a sinecure but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Minister of Revenue with concurrent acting appointment in the Ministry of Personnel. He repeatedly begged for a sinecure but was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 論楮幣自嘉定以一易二，失信天下，嚐出內帑收換，屢稱提而折閱益甚。

translations.literal: Discussing paper currency, since Jiading one note had been exchanged for two, breaking faith with the realm. The inner treasury had once been used to buy them back, and values were repeatedly raised, yet depreciation grew worse.
translations.idiomatic: Discussing paper currency, since Jiading one note had been exchanged for two, breaking faith with the realm. The inner treasury had once been used to buy them back, and values were repeatedly raised, yet depreciation grew worse.

sentences.zh: 嚐請兩界並展十年勿議造新，責州縣毋以損汙抑沮，至是遂請不立界限以絕其疑，所以區畫者甚備。

translations.literal: He had once requested that both zones extend ten years without discussing new issues, and that prefectures and counties be charged not to reject notes as damaged or soiled. At this point he requested that no limits be set to end suspicion. His plans were very thorough.
translations.idiomatic: He had once requested that both zones extend ten years without discussing new issues, and that prefectures and counties be charged not to reject notes as damaged or soiled. At this point he requested that no limits be set to end suspicion. His plans were very thorough.

sentences.zh: 其後詔宰相遍詢侍從，與歡又以前說陳之。

translations.literal: Afterward an edict ordered the chief minister to consult attendants broadly. Yuhuan again presented his earlier views.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward an edict ordered the chief minister to consult attendants broadly. Yuhuan again presented his earlier views.

sentences.zh: 有欲以端平錢當五行使，與歡謂：“開禧嚐以二當三，何救於楮。

translations.literal: Some wished to use Duanping currency as the Five Circuits envoy. Yuhuan said: 'In Kaixi two were once exchanged for three—what did that save in paper currency?'
translations.idiomatic: Some wished to use Duanping currency as the Five Circuits envoy. Yuhuan said, "In Kaixi two were once exchanged for three—what did that save in paper currency?"

sentences.zh: ”且曰：“士大夫不清白奉法，恪意扶持，雖日易一法，無救於楮，而國非其國矣。

translations.literal: He also said: 'If officials do not uphold the law with clean hands and wholeheartedly support it, though the law be changed daily, paper currency cannot be saved, and the state will no longer be the state.'
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "If officials do not uphold the law with clean hands and wholeheartedly support it, though the law be changed daily, paper currency cannot be saved, and the state will no longer be the state."

sentences.zh: 法削國弱，能獨享富貴乎？

translations.literal: When law is cut and the state weakened, can one alone enjoy wealth and honor?
translations.idiomatic: When law is cut and the state weakened, can one alone enjoy wealth and honor?

sentences.zh: ”每言“端平以來，竄贓吏，禁包苴，戒奔競，戢橫斂，而風俗沈痼自若。

translations.literal: He often said: 'Since Duanping, corrupt officials have been banished, gift-giving forbidden, frantic competition warned against, and arbitrary levies curbed, yet customs remain deeply entrenched as before.'
translations.idiomatic: He often said, "Since Duanping, corrupt officials have been banished, gift-giving forbidden, frantic competition warned against, and arbitrary levies curbed, yet customs remain deeply entrenched as before."

sentences.zh: 或口仁義而身市井，率以欺君為常，肥家為樂，遂臨事乏使，而小人得從旁乘間竊取官爵矣。

translations.literal: Some speak of benevolence and righteousness but live as market folk, routinely taking deceiving the ruler as normal and enriching the family as pleasure. Thus when affairs arise there are no men to serve, and petty men can seize the moment from the side and steal rank and office.
translations.idiomatic: Some speak of benevolence and righteousness but live as market folk, routinely taking deceiving the ruler as normal and enriching the family as pleasure. Thus when affairs arise there are no men to serve, and petty men can seize the moment and steal rank and office.

sentences.zh: ”疏乞：“別邪正，警偷惰，獎用恬退質直之士，以絕躁競浮靡之習。

translations.literal: In a memorial he begged: 'Distinguish the wicked from the upright, warn against sloth, reward and employ men of quiet withdrawal and plain integrity, to end the habit of frantic competition and empty display.'
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he begged, "Distinguish the wicked from the upright, warn against sloth, reward and employ men of quiet withdrawal and plain integrity, to end the habit of frantic competition and empty display."

sentences.zh: 內廷有關於除授者必斥，暗室有涉於謗議者必思，清心寡欲，以革酣歌黷貨之風，其機皆自陛下始。

translations.literal: Within the inner court, any matter touching appointments must be rejected; in private chambers, any matter touching slander must be considered. Purify the heart and reduce desires, to reform the wind of drunken song and corrupt gain—all must begin with Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: Within the inner court, any matter touching appointments must be rejected; in private chambers, any matter touching slander must be considered. Purify the heart and reduce desires, to reform the wind of drunken song and corrupt gain—all must begin with Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: ”又言：“軍政弛而尺籍不明，總兵者或緣功賞開嫌隙，內則班行惟求速化，守牧類多貪庸，楮事日非，浮冗不節，指陳無虛日。

translations.literal: He also said: 'Military administration is lax and rolls are unclear. Commanders sometimes open rifts over merit rewards. Within, the court ranks seek only rapid advancement; prefects and magistrates are mostly greedy and mediocre. Paper currency grows worse daily, wasteful excess is unchecked, and memorials of criticism come without idle days.'
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Military administration is lax and rolls are unclear. Commanders sometimes open rifts over merit rewards. Within, the court ranks seek only rapid advancement; prefects and magistrates are mostly greedy and mediocre. Paper currency grows worse daily, wasteful excess is unchecked, and memorials of criticism come without idle days."

sentences.zh: 大風震雷數見，因具陳邊事，且言：“人才國用，民力兵威，願乘此機，加意根本，勿徒困精神於除授，老歲月於行移，委公道於私情，付事功於無可奈何也。

translations.literal: Great wind and thunder were seen repeatedly. He thereupon fully presented border affairs and also said: 'Talent, state revenue, people's strength, and military power—I wish that we seize this moment to attend to fundamentals, not merely exhaust spirit on appointments, age the years in transfers, entrust public justice to private feeling, and leave achievement to helplessness.'
translations.idiomatic: Great wind and thunder were seen repeatedly. He thereupon fully presented border affairs and said, "Talent, state revenue, people's strength, and military power—I wish that we seize this moment to attend to fundamentals, not merely exhaust spirit on appointments, age the years in transfers, entrust public justice to private feeling, and leave achievement to helplessness."

sentences.zh: ”遷吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 講筵言：“膏雨不降，星變頻仍。

translations.literal: At the lecture hall he said: 'Timely rain does not fall, and stars change repeatedly.'
translations.idiomatic: At the lecture hall he said, "Timely rain does not fall, and stars change repeatedly."

sentences.zh: 在京物價騰踴，民訛士噪；

translations.literal: In the capital prices soar; the people spread rumors and scholars clamor;
translations.idiomatic: In the capital prices soar; the people spread rumors and scholars clamor;

sentences.zh: 在外兵權渙散，流民充斥。

translations.literal: outside military authority is scattered and displaced people fill the land.
translations.idiomatic: outside military authority is scattered and displaced people fill the land.

sentences.zh: 登崇元老，並建宰輔，謂宜風采振揚，而事勢猶若此，士大夫未必任天下之責，天下未必知陛下之誌。

translations.literal: Venerable elders have been elevated and chief ministers appointed together. One would expect spirit and bearing to be roused, yet affairs remain thus. Scholars and officials may not bear the realm's responsibility, and the realm may not know Your Majesty's will.
translations.idiomatic: Venerable elders have been elevated and chief ministers appointed together. One would expect spirit and bearing to be roused, yet affairs remain thus. Scholars and officials may not bear the realm's responsibility, and the realm may not know Your Majesty's will.

sentences.zh: ”力求歸田，會潮汐齧堤，執政道帝意留治之，手詔云：“忠正廉勤，無如卿者。

translations.literal: He forcefully sought to return to his fields. When tidal currents gnawed the dikes, the chief ministers conveyed the emperor's wish that he remain to manage it. A handwritten edict said: 'In loyalty, uprightness, integrity, and diligence, none is like you.'
translations.idiomatic: He forcefully sought to return to his fields. When tidal currents gnawed the dikes, the chief ministers conveyed the emperor's wish that he remain to manage it. A handwritten edict said, "In loyalty, uprightness, integrity, and diligence, none is like you."

sentences.zh: ”授端明殿學士、知臨安府、浙西安撫使。

translations.literal: He was appointed Academician of the Duanming Hall, prefect of Lin'an, and Pacification Commissioner of Zhexi.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Academician of the Duanming Hall, prefect of Lin'an, and Pacification Commissioner of Zhexi.

sentences.zh: 江堤竣事，獄空，力丐罷。

translations.literal: When the river dikes were completed and the prisons emptied, he forcefully begged to resign.
translations.idiomatic: When the river dikes were completed and the prisons emptied, he forcefully begged to resign.

sentences.zh: 依舊端明殿學士，提舉萬壽觀。

translations.literal: He retained his rank as Academician of the Duanming Hall and was made Superintendent of the Wanshou Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: He retained his rank as Academician of the Duanming Hall and was made Superintendent of the Wanshou Abbey.

sentences.zh: 提領戶部財用兼侍讀兼修國史、實錄院修撰。

translations.literal: He was placed in charge of Ministry of Revenue finances, concurrently Court Reader, and concurrently Compiler of the National History and Examiner of the Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: He was placed in charge of Ministry of Revenue finances, concurrently Court Reader, and concurrently Compiler of the National History and Examiner of the Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 奉朝請，出關，遣使趣還。

translations.literal: Attending court audiences, he went out through the pass. Envoys were sent to urge his return.
translations.idiomatic: Attending court audiences, he went out through the pass. Envoys were sent to urge his return.

sentences.zh: 會饑民相攜溺死，帝仍付臨安府事，恩例視執政。

translations.literal: When starving people drowned one another in groups, the emperor again entrusted him with Lin'an affairs, with honors equal to chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When starving people drowned one another in groups, the emperor again entrusted him with Lin'an affairs, with honors equal to chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 與歡涕泣奉詔，亟榜諭曰：“今申奏振救，宜忍死須臾各全性命，佇沐聖恩。

translations.literal: Yuhuan, weeping, received the edict and quickly posted a proclamation saying: 'Relief is now being memorialized. Endure death for a moment and each preserve your life, awaiting imperial grace.'
translations.idiomatic: Yuhuan, weeping, received the edict and quickly posted a proclamation saying, "Relief is now being memorialized. Endure for a moment and each preserve your life, awaiting imperial grace."

sentences.zh: ”都人相謂毋死。

translations.literal: The people of the capital told one another not to die.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the capital told one another not to die.

sentences.zh: 與歡上則祈哀公朝，下則推誠勸分，甘雨隨至，米商來集，流移至者有以濟之。

translations.literal: Yuhuan above pleaded for mercy at court, and below urged sincere sharing. Sweet rain soon came, grain merchants gathered, and those displaced and arriving were aided.
translations.idiomatic: Yuhuan above pleaded for mercy at court, and below urged sincere sharing. Sweet rain soon came, grain merchants gathered, and those displaced and arriving were aided.

sentences.zh: 力求納祿，授資政殿學士、提舉萬壽觀兼侍讀、監修國史、實錄院修撰。

translations.literal: He forcefully sought to surrender his salary. He was appointed Academician of the Zizheng Hall, Superintendent of the Wanshou Abbey, concurrently Court Reader, and Supervisor Compiler of the National History and Examiner of the Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: He forcefully sought to surrender his salary. He was appointed Academician of the Zizheng Hall, Superintendent of the Wanshou Abbey, concurrently Court Reader, and Supervisor Compiler of the National History and Examiner of the Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 奉朝請，與歡至浙江，上召還，即日絕江去，帝為悵然。

translations.literal: Attending court audiences, Yuhuan reached Zhejiang. The emperor summoned him back, but that very day he crossed the river and departed. The emperor was deeply regretful.
translations.idiomatic: Attending court audiences, Yuhuan reached Zhejiang. The emperor summoned him back, but that very day he crossed the river and departed. The emperor was deeply regretful.

sentences.zh: 與歡三為府尹，盡力民事，都人稱“趙端明”，必以手加額曰“趙佛子”也。

translations.literal: Yuhuan three times served as prefectural governor, exerting himself fully in the people's affairs. The people of the capital called him 'Zhao Duanming' and invariably placed their hands to their foreheads, saying 'Zhao the Buddha-son.'
translations.idiomatic: Yuhuan three times served as prefectural governor, exerting himself fully in the people's affairs. The people of the capital called him "Zhao Duanming" and invariably placed their hands to their foreheads, saying "Zhao the Buddha-son."

sentences.zh: 久之，以舊職知溫州，政事必親，吏不敢欺，創水砦，修貢院。

translations.literal: After some time, with his former rank he governed Wen Prefecture. He personally handled all affairs of government, and clerks dared not deceive him. He created water fortresses and repaired the tribute examination hall.
translations.idiomatic: After some time, with his former rank he governed Wen Prefecture. He personally handled all affairs of government, and clerks dared not deceive him. He created water fortresses and repaired the tribute examination hall.

sentences.zh: 以侍讀召，辭，不許。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Court Reader. He declined but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as Court Reader. He declined but was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 入對，言爵祿之濫，因及國本事。

translations.literal: Entering audience he spoke of the abuse of ranks and stipends and also touched on the matter of the succession.
translations.idiomatic: Entering audience he spoke of the abuse of ranks and stipends and also touched on the matter of the succession.

sentences.zh: 五丐歸，又不許。

translations.literal: He five times begged to retire, and again was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He five times begged to retire, and again was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 進《春秋解》，升大學士，薦士六十人。

translations.literal: He presented his Explication of the Spring and Autumn Annals, was promoted to Grand Academician, and recommended sixty scholars.
translations.idiomatic: He presented his Explication of the Spring and Autumn Annals, was promoted to Grand Academician, and recommended sixty scholars.

sentences.zh: 史嵩之將復入相，而人言不已，帝以問與歡。

translations.literal: Shi Songzhi was about to re-enter the chief ministership, but public talk did not cease. The emperor asked Yuhuan.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Songzhi was about to re-enter the chief ministership, but public talk did not cease. The emperor asked Yuhuan.

sentences.zh: 言：“嵩之老師費財，私昵貪富，過立名譽，必不宜復用。

translations.literal: He said: 'Songzhi is old, wasteful of resources, privately favors the greedy and rich, and excessively builds reputation. He must not be reused.'
translations.idiomatic: He said, "Songzhi is old, wasteful of resources, privately favors the greedy and rich, and excessively builds reputation. He must not be reused."

sentences.zh: ”時嵩之猶子璟卿誦言其過忽斃，而杜範、劉漢弼、徐元傑三賢暴死，人皆疑嵩之致毒。

translations.literal: At that time Songzhi's nephew Jingqing, who had publicly recited his faults, suddenly died. The three worthy men Du Fan, Liu Hanbi, and Xu Yuanjie also died violently. All suspected Songzhi of poisoning them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Songzhi's nephew Jingqing, who had publicly recited his faults, suddenly died. The three worthy men Du Fan, Liu Hanbi, and Xu Yuanjie also died violently. All suspected Songzhi of poisoning them.

sentences.zh: 與歡請優恤漢弼、元傑家，帝從之，而優恤手詔，則與歡所擬入也。

translations.literal: Yuhuan requested generous relief for the families of Hanbi and Yuanjie. The emperor agreed, and the handwritten edict of relief was drafted by Yuhuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yuhuan requested generous relief for the families of Hanbi and Yuanjie. The emperor agreed, and the handwritten edict of relief was drafted by Yuhuan.

sentences.zh: 又請以兵財分任輔臣。

translations.literal: He also requested that military affairs and finances be divided among vice ministers.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested that military affairs and finances be divided among vice ministers.

sentences.zh: 在講筵言：“以壞證付庸醫，僅支殘息，徒運巧心，天下事尚堪再誤耶？

translations.literal: At the lecture hall he said: 'To entrust a grave illness to a mediocre doctor, barely sustaining the last breath while merely exercising cleverness—can affairs of the realm still afford another mistake?'
translations.idiomatic: At the lecture hall he said, "To entrust a grave illness to a mediocre doctor, barely sustaining the last breath while merely exercising cleverness—can affairs of the realm still afford another mistake?"

sentences.zh: ”時相忌之。

translations.literal: The chief minister resented him.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister resented him.

sentences.zh: 尋授安德軍節度使、開府儀同三司、萬壽觀使。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Military Commissioner of Ande Army, Grand Master with the Same Honor as the Three Excellencies, and Superintendent of the Wanshou Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed Military Commissioner of Ande Army, Grand Master with the Same Honor as the Three Excellencies, and Superintendent of the Wanshou Abbey.

sentences.zh: 日食，應詔言事益切。

translations.literal: At a solar eclipse, responding to the edict, his words grew still more urgent.
translations.idiomatic: At a solar eclipse, responding to the edict, his words grew still more urgent.

sentences.zh: 月賜內帑，與歡辭不取。

translations.literal: Monthly gifts from the inner treasury were declined by Yuhuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yuhuan declined the monthly gifts from the inner treasury.

sentences.zh: 帝書“安貧樂道，植節秉忠”字賜之。

translations.literal: The emperor wrote the characters 'Content in poverty, delighting in the Way; planting integrity, holding to loyalty' and bestowed them on him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wrote the characters "Content in poverty, delighting in the Way; planting integrity, holding to loyalty" and bestowed them on him.

sentences.zh: 建儲未定，乃申言之，又言：“人才乏使，贓吏不悛，民昔流而南，今流而北，盜昔伏於遠，今伏於近，體認不真，賢否無別，國將誰與立邪？

translations.literal: The heir apparent was not yet established, and he again spoke of this. He also said: 'Talent is lacking for service, corrupt officials do not reform, the people once fled south and now flee north, bandits once hid afar and now hide nearby, judgment is not genuine, worthy and unworthy are not distinguished—with whom will the state stand?'
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent was not yet established, and he again spoke of this. He also said, "Talent is lacking for service, corrupt officials do not reform, the people once fled south and now flee north, bandits once hid afar and now hide nearby, judgment is not genuine, worthy and unworthy are not distinguished—with whom will the state stand?"

sentences.zh: 願富一代之儲，使小人無間可投，以絕隱伏之禍。

translations.literal: I wish to enrich the store of a generation, so that petty men have no gap to enter and hidden calamity is ended.
translations.idiomatic: I wish to enrich the store of a generation, so that petty men have no gap to enter and hidden calamity is ended.

sentences.zh: ”帝為改容。

translations.literal: The emperor's expression changed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's expression changed.

sentences.zh: 袁士宋斌少從黃幹、李燔登朱熹之門，學禁方嚴，羈旅困沮，年且八十，與歡延之，事以父行，奏乞用旌禮布衣故事，死葬西湖上，歲一祭焉。

translations.literal: Yuan Shi Song Bin in youth followed Huang Gan and Li Fan to enter Zhu Xi's gate. When the learning ban was strict he was stranded in hardship. Nearly eighty years old, Yuhuan invited him and treated him with a father's courtesy. He memorialized requesting the precedent of honoring a commoner, that upon death he be buried on West Lake with annual sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Song Bin of Yuan Shi in youth followed Huang Gan and Li Fan to study under Zhu Xi. When the learning ban was strict he was stranded in hardship. Nearly eighty years old, Yuhuan invited him and treated him with a father's courtesy. He memorialized requesting the precedent of honoring a commoner, that upon death he be buried on West Lake with annual sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 帝逐二諫臣，與歡力爭之。

translations.literal: The emperor expelled two remonstrating officials. Yuhuan forcefully contested this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor expelled two remonstrating officials. Yuhuan forcefully contested this.

sentences.zh: 五乞免朝請，三乞致仕，俱不允，賜《泰卦詩》、《忠邪辨》。

translations.literal: He five times begged exemption from court audiences and three times begged retirement. None was granted. He was granted the Poem on the Hexagram Tai and Discrimination of Loyalty and Treachery.
translations.idiomatic: He five times begged exemption from court audiences and three times begged retirement. None was granted. He was granted the Poem on the Hexagram Tai and Discrimination of Loyalty and Treachery.

sentences.zh: 自是，國事皆縷縷言之，有不勝書，蓋其愛君憂國，本諸天性。

translations.literal: From then on he spoke of state affairs in detail, more than can be written. His love of the ruler and concern for the state sprang from his nature.
translations.idiomatic: From then on he spoke of state affairs in detail, more than can be written. His love of the ruler and concern for the state sprang from his nature.

sentences.zh: 拜少傅，卒，遺表猶不忘規正。

translations.literal: He was appointed Junior Preceptor and died. His death memorial still did not forget admonition and correction.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Junior Preceptor and died. His death memorial still did not forget admonition and correction.

sentences.zh: 帝震悼輟朝，賻贈有加，詔有司治葬，贈少師，追封奉化郡王，諡清敏，累贈太師。

translations.literal: The emperor was shaken with grief and suspended court audiences. Funeral gifts were increased. An edict ordered officials to manage the burial. He was posthumously granted the title of Junior Preceptor, enfeoffed as Prince of Fenghua Commandery, given the posthumous name Qingmin, and repeatedly promoted posthumously to Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was shaken with grief and suspended court audiences. Funeral gifts were increased. An edict ordered officials to manage the burial. He was posthumously granted the title of Junior Preceptor, enfeoffed as Prince of Fenghua Commandery, given the posthumous name Qingmin, and repeatedly promoted posthumously to Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 手注《六經》及《仁皇訓典詳釋》，又有《高宗寶訓要釋》、奏議、詩文百卷。

translations.literal: He personally annotated the Six Classics and Detailed Explication of Emperor Renzong's Instruction Canon. He also had Essentials of Emperor Gaozong's Precious Instruction, memorials, and poetry and prose in one hundred juan.
translations.idiomatic: He personally annotated the Six Classics and Detailed Explication of Emperor Renzong's Instruction Canon. He also wrote Essentials of Emperor Gaozong's Precious Instruction, memorials, and poetry and prose in one hundred juan.

sentences.zh: 與歡嚐謂：“士大夫有貪聲，則雖奇才奧學，徒以蠹國害民爾。

translations.literal: Yuhuan once said: 'If a scholar-official has a reputation for greed, then though he have extraordinary talent and profound learning, he merely harms the state and injures the people.'
translations.idiomatic: Yuhuan once said, "If a scholar-official has a reputation for greed, then though he have extraordinary talent and profound learning, he merely harms the state and injures the people."

sentences.zh: ”故斂之夕，而金帶猶質錢民家雲。

translations.literal: Therefore on the night of his encoffining, his gold belt was still pledged at a commoner's house.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore on the night of his encoffining, his gold belt was still pledged at a commoner's house.

sentences.zh: 趙必願，字立夫，廣西經略安撫崇憲之子也。

translations.literal: Zhao Biyuan, styled Lifu, was the son of Chongxian, Military Commissioner and Pacification Commissioner of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Biyuan, courtesy name Lifu, was the son of Chongxian, Military Commissioner and Pacification Commissioner of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 未弱冠，丁大母憂，哀毀骨立。

translations.literal: Before reaching the age of twenty he completed mourning for his grandmother. Grief wasted him until only bones remained.
translations.idiomatic: Before reaching twenty he completed mourning for his grandmother. Grief wasted him until he was skin and bones.

sentences.zh: 服闋，以大父汝愚遺表，補承務郎。

translations.literal: When mourning ended, through his grandfather Ruyu's death memorial he was granted the office of Chengwu Lang.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended, through his grandfather Ruyu's death memorial he received the rank of Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement.

sentences.zh: 開禧元年，銓監平江府糧料院，調常熟丞。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaixi he was selected as superintendent of the Grain Office of Pingjiang Prefecture and transferred as assistant magistrate of Changshu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Kaixi reign (1205) he was selected as superintendent of the Grain Office of Pingjiang Prefecture and transferred as assistant magistrate of Changshu.

sentences.zh: 嘉定七年舉進士，知崇安縣，剖判如流，吏不能困。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiading he passed the jinshi examination, governed Chong'an County, judged cases with flowing ease, and clerks could not trouble him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of the Jiading reign (1214) he passed the jinshi examinations, governed Chong'an County, judged cases with flowing ease, and clerks could not trouble him.

sentences.zh: 修學政，立催科法，列戶名為三等，以三期為約，足者旌之，未足者寬以趣之，逾期不納者裏胥程督之，民皆感懌願輸。

translations.literal: He reformed school administration and established a tax collection law, listing households in three grades. With three periods as the term, those who paid in full were honored, those not yet full were given grace to hurry payment, and those overdue were supervised by village clerks. The people all felt moved and willingly paid.
translations.idiomatic: He reformed school administration and established a tax collection law, listing households in three grades. With three periods as the term, those who paid in full were honored, those not yet full were given grace to hurry payment, and those overdue were supervised by village clerks. The people all felt moved and willingly paid.

sentences.zh: 革胥吏鬻鹽之敝。

translations.literal: He reformed the abuse of clerks selling salt.
translations.idiomatic: He reformed the abuse of clerks selling salt.

sentences.zh: 擅發光化社倉活饑民，帥怒，逮吏欲懲之，必願曰：“芻牧職也，吏何罪。

translations.literal: He on his own authority opened the Guanghua communal granary to save starving people. The commissioner was angry and arrested the clerk to punish him. Biyuan said: 'It is the duty of the grass and herd officer. What crime has the clerk?'
translations.idiomatic: He on his own authority opened the Guanghua communal granary to save starving people. The commissioner was angry and arrested the clerk to punish him. Biyuan said, "It is the duty of the grass and herd officer. What crime has the clerk?"

sentences.zh: ”束簷俟譴，帥無以詰而止。

translations.literal: He bound himself at the eaves awaiting punishment. The commissioner had no way to press further and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He bound himself at the eaves awaiting punishment. The commissioner had no way to press further and stopped.

sentences.zh: 舊有均惠倉，無所儲，必願捐緡錢增糴，至二千石。

translations.literal: There was formerly an Equal Benefit Granary with nothing stored. Biyuan donated cash to increase purchases, reaching two thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: There was formerly an Equal Benefit Granary with nothing stored. Biyuan donated cash to increase purchases, reaching two thousand shi.

sentences.zh: 力主義役之法，鄉選善士，任以推排，入資買田助役，則勉有產之家，有感化者，出己田以倡，遂遍行一邑，上下便之。

translations.literal: He forcefully advocated the law of voluntary corvée service. Good men were selected in the villages and entrusted with assessment. Those who contributed funds to buy fields to support corvée were encouraged, and among property-owning families some were moved to offer their own fields as examples. Thus it spread throughout the county, and all found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: He forcefully advocated the law of voluntary corvée service. Good men were selected in the villages and entrusted with assessment. Those who contributed funds to buy fields to support corvée were encouraged, and among property-owning families some were moved to offer their own fields as examples. Thus it spread throughout the county, and all found it convenient.

sentences.zh: 台府以聞，下其式八郡四十八縣。

translations.literal: The provincial office reported it, and its model was issued to eight prefectures and forty-eight counties.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial office reported it, and its model was issued to eight prefectures and forty-eight counties.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，民共立祠刻石。

translations.literal: When his term ended, the people jointly erected a shrine and carved a stone inscription.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended, the people jointly erected a shrine and carved a stone inscription.

sentences.zh: 授湖、廣總所幹辦公事。

translations.literal: He was appointed staff officer of the General Office of Hu and Guang.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed staff officer of the General Office of Hu and Guang.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂，居喪盡禮，貽書問學於黃幹。

translations.literal: Completing mourning for his father, he observed the rites fully and sent letters to Huang Gan to inquire about learning.
translations.idiomatic: Completing mourning for his father, he observed the rites fully and sent letters to Huang Gan to inquire about learning.

sentences.zh: 服除，差充兩浙運司主管文字。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was assigned as document officer of the Liangzhe Transport Commission.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was assigned as document officer of the Liangzhe Transport Commission.

sentences.zh: 再考，特差充提領安邊所主管文字。

translations.literal: After a second evaluation he was specially assigned as document officer of the Frontier Security Office.
translations.idiomatic: After a second evaluation he was specially assigned as document officer of the Frontier Security Office.

sentences.zh: 差知全州，陛辭，奏乞下道、江二州訪周惇頤之後。

translations.literal: He was assigned to govern Quan Prefecture. At his farewell audience he memorialized begging that Dao and Jiang Prefectures be searched for descendants of Zhou Dunyi.
translations.idiomatic: He was assigned to govern Quan Prefecture. At his farewell audience he memorialized asking that Dao and Jiang Prefectures be searched for descendants of Zhou Dunyi.

sentences.zh: 知常州，改知處州，陳折帛納銀之害，皆得請。

translations.literal: He governed Chang Prefecture, then was transferred to govern Chu Prefecture. He presented the harms of exchanging silk for silver payments, and all his requests were granted.
translations.idiomatic: He governed Chang Prefecture, then was transferred to govern Chu Prefecture. He presented the harms of exchanging silk for silver payments, and all his requests were granted.

sentences.zh: 移泉州，罷白土課及免差吏榷鐵，諷諸邑行義役。

translations.literal: Transferred to Quanzhou, he abolished the White Earth levy and exempted dispatched clerks from the iron monopoly, and urged all counties to implement voluntary corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Quanzhou, he abolished the White Earth levy and exempted dispatched clerks from the iron monopoly, and urged all counties to implement voluntary corvée.

sentences.zh: 秋旱，力講行荒政，乞撥永儲、廣儲二倉米振救。

translations.literal: In autumn drought he forcefully urged famine relief measures and begged allocation of grain from the Ever-Store and Broad-Store granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: During an autumn drought he forcefully urged famine relief measures and begged allocation of grain from the Ever-Store and Broad-Store granaries for relief.

sentences.zh: 差主管官告院。

translations.literal: He was assigned to administer the Patent Office.
translations.idiomatic: He was assigned to administer the Patent Office.

sentences.zh: 越五日，詔依舊主管官告院兼知台州，一循大父之政，察民疾苦，撫摩凋瘵，修養濟院，建陳瓘祠，政教兼舉。

translations.literal: Within five days an edict ordered him to continue administering the Patent Office and concurrently govern Taizhou. He followed his grandfather's policies, observed the people's hardships, comforted the afflicted, repaired the Relief Institute, built a shrine to Chen Guan, and pursued both governance and instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Within five days an edict ordered him to continue administering the Patent Office and concurrently govern Taizhou. He followed his grandfather's policies, observed the people's hardships, comforted the afflicted, repaired the Relief Institute, built a shrine to Chen Guan, and pursued both governance and instruction.

sentences.zh: 端平元年，以直秘閣知婺州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Duanping he was made Direct Attendant of the Secret Pavilion and prefect of Wu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Duanping reign (1234) he was made Direct Attendant of the Secret Pavilion and prefect of Wu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至郡，免催紹定六年分小戶綾羅錢三萬緡有奇。

translations.literal: Upon reaching the prefecture he remitted collection of more than thirty thousand strings of cash for silk and gauze owed by small households from the sixth year of Shaoding.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching the prefecture he remitted collection of more than thirty thousand strings of cash for silk and gauze owed by small households from the sixth year of Shaoding.

sentences.zh: 立淳良、頑慢二籍，勸懲人戶。

translations.literal: He established two registers, Pure and Good and Stubborn and Slow, to encourage and punish households.
translations.idiomatic: He established two registers, Pure and Good and Stubborn and Slow, to encourage and punish households.

sentences.zh: 措置廣惠倉及諸倉積穀。

translations.literal: He arranged the Broad Benefit Granary and accumulated grain in various granaries.
translations.idiomatic: He arranged the Broad Benefit Granary and accumulated grain in various granaries.

sentences.zh: 奏乞寬減內帑綾羅，申省免用舊例，預解諸色窠名錢，罷開化稅場。

translations.literal: He memorialized begging reduction of inner treasury silk and gauze, reported to the province exemption from old precedents, prepaid various category funds, and abolished the Kaihua tax station.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized asking reduction of inner treasury silk and gauze, reported to the province exemption from old precedents, prepaid various category funds, and abolished the Kaihua tax station.

sentences.zh: 遷太府寺丞，尋遷度支郎中。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Assistant Director of the Grand Treasury and soon to Director of the Budget Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Assistant Director of the Grand Treasury and soon to Director of the Budget Bureau.

sentences.zh: 詔以汝愚配享寧宗，從必願請也。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Ruyu to share sacrifice with Emperor Ningzong, following Biyuan's request.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Ruyu to share sacrifice with Emperor Ningzong, following Biyuan's request.

sentences.zh: 兼右司郎中，引見，疏言：

translations.literal: Concurrently Right Department Secretary, he was presented in audience and memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: Concurrently Right Department Secretary, he was presented in audience and memorialized:

sentences.zh: 陛下英明密運，斷出於獨，固欲一切轉移之。

translations.literal: Your Majesty is wise and secret in operation, decisions issuing from yourself alone, and truly wishes to transform everything.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is wise and secret in operation, decisions issuing from yourself alone, and truly wishes to transform everything.

sentences.zh: 然而大權若在我，或者猶有下移之疑；

translations.literal: Yet if great authority seems to be in my hands, some may still suspect it has shifted downward;
translations.idiomatic: Yet if great authority seems to be in your hands, some may still suspect it has shifted downward;

sentences.zh: 眾正若已開，或者猶有旁徑之疑。

translations.literal: if the upright have already been opened, some may still suspect side paths.
translations.idiomatic: if the upright have already been welcomed, some may still suspect side paths.

sentences.zh: 策免二相，銷天變也，去者固難以復留，留者恐終於引去。

translations.literal: Dismissing the two chief ministers dispels celestial anomalies, yet those who leave can hardly be kept, and those who remain may ultimately withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Dismissing the two chief ministers dispels celestial anomalies, yet those who leave can hardly be kept, and those who remain may ultimately withdraw.

sentences.zh: 虛鼎席以待故老，疑者或意其未必來，而況在數千里之外；

translations.literal: Leaving the chief minister's seat empty to await old veterans—doubters may think they will not come, especially when thousands of li away;
translations.idiomatic: Leaving the chief minister's seat empty to await old veterans—doubters may think they will not come, especially when thousands of li away;

sentences.zh: 責次補以任大政，疑者或意其不敢專，而況於不安其位。

translations.literal: charging the next in rank to handle great affairs—doubters may think they dare not act independently, especially when insecure in their posts.
translations.idiomatic: charging the next in rank to handle great affairs—doubters may think they dare not act independently, especially when insecure in their posts.

sentences.zh: 中書，政之本也。

translations.literal: The Secretariat is the root of government.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat is the root of government.

sentences.zh: 今果何時，尚可含糊意向以啟天下之疑乎？

translations.literal: What time is this now—can ambiguous intentions still be used to open doubt throughout the realm?
translations.idiomatic: What time is this now—can ambiguous intentions still be used to open doubt throughout the realm?

sentences.zh: 親擢台諫，開言路也，用之未久者，何為輕於易去？

translations.literal: Personally elevating censors and remonstrators opens the path of speech. Why lightly dismiss those not long in use?
translations.idiomatic: Personally elevating censors and remonstrators opens the path of speech. Why lightly dismiss those not long in use?

sentences.zh: 去之未幾，何為使之復來？

translations.literal: Why, not long after dismissal, have them return?
translations.idiomatic: Why, not long after dismissal, have them return?

sentences.zh: 召於外服者，不知果能用之而必堅；

translations.literal: Those summoned from outside service—one does not know whether they will truly be used and held firm;
translations.idiomatic: Those summoned from outside service—one does not know whether they will truly be used and held firm;

sentences.zh: 除目周行者，不知果能聽之而無諱乎？

translations.literal: appointment orders circulating widely—one does not know whether they will truly be heard without concealment?
translations.idiomatic: appointment orders circulating widely—one does not know whether they will truly be heard without concealment?

sentences.zh: 朝廷除授，軍國賞罰，本至公也，今有姓名未達於廟堂，而遷擢忽由於中出，斥逐三衙，竟不指名罪狀，而人始得以疑陛下矣。

translations.literal: Court appointments and military rewards and punishments are originally utterly public. Now names have not reached the temple hall, yet promotions suddenly issue from within; the Three Commands are expelled without naming crimes—and people can begin to doubt Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: Court appointments and military rewards and punishments are originally utterly public. Now names have not reached the temple hall, yet promotions suddenly issue from within; the Three Commands are expelled without naming crimes—and people can begin to doubt Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 一除目之頒，一號令之出，雖未必由於閹宦，而人或疑於閹宦；

translations.literal: One appointment order issued, one command sent out—though not necessarily from eunuchs, people may suspect eunuchs;
translations.idiomatic: One appointment order issued, one command sent out—though not necessarily from eunuchs, people may suspect eunuchs;

sentences.zh: 雖未必由於私謁，而人或疑於私謁；

translations.literal: though not necessarily from private audiences, people may suspect private audiences;
translations.idiomatic: though not necessarily from private audiences, people may suspect private audiences;

sentences.zh: 雖未必由於戚畹宗邸，而人或疑於戚畹宗邸。

translations.literal: though not necessarily from imperial in-laws and princely residences, people may suspect imperial in-laws and princely residences.
translations.idiomatic: though not necessarily from imperial in-laws and princely residences, people may suspect imperial in-laws and princely residences.

sentences.zh: 夫天下者，祖宗之天下也，非陛下所私有也，陛下雖有去敝之心，而動涉可疑之跡，陛下亦何樂於此。

translations.literal: The realm is the realm of the ancestors, not Your Majesty's private possession. Though Your Majesty has a heart to remove abuses, actions touch suspicious traces—what pleasure is there in this for Your Majesty?
translations.idiomatic: The realm is the realm of the ancestors, not Your Majesty's private possession. Though Your Majesty has a heart to remove abuses, actions touch suspicious traces—what pleasure is there in this for Your Majesty?

sentences.zh: 時論偉之。

translations.literal: Contemporary opinion praised him greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Contemporary opinion praised him greatly.

sentences.zh: 三京兵敗，邊事甚亟，詔條上守禦計，必願言十事：下哀痛之詔，合江淮之兵，救江陵之急，節財用之宜，縻議和之使，撫無歸之民，處北來之眾，置鎮撫之使，擇帥閫之代，拔未用之將，皆切於邊要。

translations.literal: When the Three Capitals army was defeated and border affairs were extremely urgent, an edict ordered memorials listing defense plans. Biyuan spoke of ten matters: issue a grief-stricken edict, combine Jiang-Huai troops, relieve Jiangling's crisis, economize expenditures, detain peace envoys, comfort displaced people, settle northern arrivals, appoint pacification commissioners, choose replacements for commanders, and promote unused generals—all urgent for the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: When the Three Capitals army was defeated and border affairs were extremely urgent, an edict ordered memorials listing defense plans. Biyuan spoke of ten matters: issue a grief-stricken edict, combine Jiang-Huai troops, relieve Jiangling's crisis, economize expenditures, detain peace envoys, comfort displaced people, settle northern arrivals, appoint pacification commissioners, choose replacements for commanders, and promote unused generals—all urgent for the frontier.

sentences.zh: 政府議楮幣日輕，欲令諸州再用印及他為稱提之法，必願力爭不可。

translations.literal: The government discussed paper currency growing lighter daily and wished to order prefectures to re-stamp notes and adopt other methods of raising value. Biyuan forcefully argued this must not be done.
translations.idiomatic: The government discussed paper currency growing lighter daily and wished to order prefectures to re-stamp notes and adopt other methods of raising value. Biyuan forcefully argued this must not be done.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙元年，貽書政府，論邊防事宜，授右司郎中。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaxi he sent a letter to the government discussing frontier defense and was appointed Right Department Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Jiaxi reign (1237) he sent a letter to the government discussing frontier defense and was appointed Right Department Secretary.

sentences.zh: 火災，必願應詔上封事，曰：“開邊稔禍之刑，牽製而未行；

translations.literal: At a fire disaster Biyuan responded to the edict with a sealed memorial, saying: 'Punishment for those who repeatedly brought border calamity is held back and not carried out;
translations.idiomatic: At a fire disaster Biyuan responded to the edict with a sealed memorial, saying, "Punishment for those who repeatedly brought border calamity is held back and not carried out;

sentences.zh: 激變棄城之戮，姑息而未舉。

translations.literal: execution for those who provoked revolt and abandoned cities is indulged and not applied.
translations.idiomatic: execution for those who provoked revolt and abandoned cities is indulged and not applied.

sentences.zh: 京、襄淪沒，祖宗之基業莫能保；

translations.literal: Jing and Xiang have fallen, and the ancestors' foundation cannot be preserved;
translations.idiomatic: Jing and Xiang have fallen, and the ancestors' foundation cannot be preserved;

sentences.zh: 淮、蜀蹂躪，赤子之冤魂無所依。

translations.literal: Huai and Shu are trampled, and the innocent souls of the people have nowhere to rest.
translations.idiomatic: Huai and Shu are trampled, and the innocent souls of the people have nowhere to rest.

sentences.zh: 履畝之令下而加以抑配，稱提之法嚴而重以告訐。

translations.literal: Orders to survey fields are issued and forced allocation is added; methods to raise currency value are strict and reporting is heavily emphasized.
translations.idiomatic: Orders to survey fields are issued and forced allocation is added; methods to raise currency value are strict and reporting is heavily emphasized.

sentences.zh: 民無蓋藏，每有轉壑之憂；

translations.literal: The people have no reserves and constantly fear starvation in ditches;
translations.idiomatic: The people have no reserves and constantly fear starvation in ditches;

sentences.zh: 士不宿飽，常有思亂之誌。

translations.literal: scholars are not fed overnight and constantly harbor thoughts of disorder.
translations.idiomatic: scholars are not fed overnight and constantly harbor thoughts of disorder.

sentences.zh: ”又曰：“台諫、給舍骨鯁之論莫容；

translations.literal: He also said: 'Blunt speech from censors and remonstrators is not tolerated;
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Blunt speech from censors and remonstrators is not tolerated;

sentences.zh: 左右便嬖浸潤之言易入。

translations.literal: insinuating words from favorites at one's side easily enter.'
translations.idiomatic: insinuating words from favorites at one's side easily enter."

sentences.zh: 春夏常享，闊略於原廟之尊；

translations.literal: Regular spring and summer sacrifices are neglected toward the honor of the original temple;
translations.idiomatic: Regular spring and summer sacrifices are neglected toward the honor of the original temple;

sentences.zh: 節鉞隆恩，殷勤於邸第之貴。

translations.literal: military honors and grand favor are lavished on the nobility of princely residences.
translations.idiomatic: military honors and grand favor are lavished on the nobility of princely residences.

sentences.zh: ”又曰：“必也正故相專國之罪，嚴貪夫徇國之誅，思室鬼高明之瞰。

translations.literal: He also said: 'The former chief minister's crime of monopolizing the state must be corrected; punishment for greedy men who ruined the state must be strict; think of the lofty gaze of the ancestral spirits.'
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "The former chief minister's crime of monopolizing the state must be corrected; punishment for greedy men who ruined the state must be strict; think of the lofty gaze of the ancestral spirits."

sentences.zh: 先編氓，後親貴，去木妖競治之釁；

translations.literal: First the common people, then the imperial kin; remove the omen of tree demons competing for governance;
translations.idiomatic: First the common people, then the imperial kin; remove the omen of tree demons competing for governance;

sentences.zh: 尚堅固，革奢華，戒宴殿無度之宴酣，節內庭不急之營繕。

translations.literal: value solidity, reform extravagance, warn against unrestrained feasting in banquet halls, and economize on non-urgent repairs in the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: value solidity, reform extravagance, warn against unrestrained feasting in banquet halls, and economize on non-urgent repairs in the inner court.

sentences.zh: ”又論濟王及國本事。

translations.literal: He also discussed the Prince of Ji and the matter of the succession.
translations.idiomatic: He also discussed the Prince of Ji and the matter of the succession.

sentences.zh: 遷左司郎中，又遷司農少卿兼左司。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Left Department Secretary and again to Vice Director of Agriculture with concurrent Left Department duty.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Left Department Secretary and again to Vice Director of Agriculture with concurrent Left Department duty.

sentences.zh: 轉對，言：“正氣日消月沮，馴至今日，非惟搢紳不肯論事，下至草茅之士，皆結舌矣。

translations.literal: At a rotating audience he said: 'Righteous spirit daily wanes and monthly declines, until today not only do gentry refuse to discuss affairs—even down to common scholars, all are tongue-tied.'
translations.idiomatic: At a rotating audience he said, "Righteous spirit daily wanes and monthly declines, until today not only do gentry refuse to discuss affairs—even down to common scholars, all are tongue-tied."

sentences.zh: 端平初年，沉屙方去，新病未作，陛下猶勤於谘訪，如恐不及。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Duanping, deep illness had just departed and new sickness had not yet appeared. Your Majesty still diligently consulted, as if fearing to fall short.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Duanping, deep illness had just departed and new sickness had not yet appeared. Your Majesty still diligently consulted, as if fearing to fall short.

sentences.zh: 今疾攻心腹，決裂將潰，乃不求瞑眩之劑以起其殆，甚可惑也。

translations.literal: Now sickness attacks the heart and belly, about to rupture and collapse, yet you do not seek the dizzying medicine to rouse the dying—this is deeply puzzling.
translations.idiomatic: Now sickness attacks the heart and belly, about to rupture and collapse, yet you do not seek the drastic medicine to rouse the dying—this is deeply puzzling.

sentences.zh: ”又曰：“毋使人臣以指斥懷疑，毋致陛下以厭言得謗。

translations.literal: He also said: 'Do not let ministers harbor suspicion through criticism; do not let Your Majesty be slandered for tiring of speech.'
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Do not let ministers harbor suspicion through criticism; do not let Your Majesty be slandered for tiring of speech."

sentences.zh: ”時直士相繼去，故必願及之。

translations.literal: At that time upright men were leaving one after another, so Biyuan spoke of this.
translations.idiomatic: At that time upright men were leaving one after another, so Biyuan spoke of this.

sentences.zh: 兼敕令所刪修官，拜司農卿，兼職如故。

translations.literal: Concurrently editor at the Statutes Office, he was appointed Director of Agriculture with concurrent duties unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Concurrently editor at the Statutes Office, he was appointed Director of Agriculture with concurrent duties unchanged.

sentences.zh: 翼日，改宗正少卿，仍兼刪修敕令兼國史編修實錄檢討，尋兼左司，遷太府卿，仍兼編修、檢討，遷宗正少卿。

translations.literal: The next day he was transferred to Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court, still concurrently editing statutes and compiling the National History and Veritable Records, soon concurrently Left Department, promoted to Director of the Grand Treasury, still concurrently compiling and examining, and transferred to Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he was transferred to Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court, still concurrently editing statutes and compiling the National History and Veritable Records, soon concurrently Left Department, promoted to Director of the Grand Treasury, still concurrently compiling and examining, and transferred to Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 詔依舊太府卿，仍兼職，且兼中書門下檢正諸房公事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him to retain his rank as Director of the Grand Treasury with concurrent duties, and also concurrently Investigating Officer of the various bureaus of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered him to retain his rank as Director of the Grand Treasury with concurrent duties, and also concurrently Investigating Officer of the various bureaus of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 轉對，言：“中才庸主，惟其無所知覺，故言不可入，而敗亡隨之。

translations.literal: At a rotating audience he said: 'Mediocre talent and a mediocre ruler, because they know and perceive nothing, words cannot enter, and ruin follows.'
translations.idiomatic: At a rotating audience he said, "Mediocre talent and a mediocre ruler, because they know and perceive nothing, words cannot enter, and ruin follows."

sentences.zh: 陛下作敬天之圖，朝夕對越，謂宜天意可回，而熒惑失度，鬱攸煽災，迫近禁門，幾毀左藏。

translations.literal: Your Majesty made a diagram for revering Heaven and morning and evening faced it, thinking Heaven's will could be turned. Yet Mars lost its measure, fires blazed in disaster, approaching the forbidden gate and nearly destroying the Left Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty made a diagram for revering Heaven and morning and evening faced it, thinking Heaven's will could be turned. Yet Mars lost its measure, fires blazed in disaster, approaching the forbidden gate and nearly destroying the Left Treasury.

sentences.zh: 煙埃方息，白晝隕星，貫日之虹，脅陽之雹，疊見層出。

translations.literal: Smoke and dust had just settled when stars fell in daylight, sun-piercing rainbows and sun-threatening hail appeared layer upon layer.
translations.idiomatic: Smoke and dust had just settled when stars fell in daylight, sun-piercing rainbows and sun-threatening hail appeared layer upon layer.

sentences.zh: 陛下觀時察變，何由致此？

translations.literal: Your Majesty observes the times and examines changes—by what is this caused?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty observes the times and examines changes—by what is this caused?

sentences.zh: 今日之事，動無良策，惟在側身修行，祈天永命而已。

translations.literal: In today's affairs there are no good policies in motion. There is only to straighten oneself and cultivate virtue, praying Heaven for enduring mandate.
translations.idiomatic: In today's affairs there are no good policies in motion. There is only to straighten oneself and cultivate virtue, praying Heaven for enduring mandate.

sentences.zh: ”遷起居舍人，兼職仍舊。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Diarist with concurrent duties unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Diarist with concurrent duties unchanged.

sentences.zh: 大水，上封事曰：“海潮毀隘，侵迫禁城，災異之來，理不虛發，必上畏天戒，下修人事，易沴召和，轉移於陛下方寸間耳。

translations.literal: At great flood he submitted a sealed memorial, saying: 'Sea tides destroy barriers and press upon the forbidden city. When calamities come, principle is not empty in their occurrence. Above one must fear Heaven's warning; below one must cultivate human affairs. Change calamity and summon harmony—it turns on Your Majesty's mind alone.'
translations.idiomatic: At great flood he submitted a sealed memorial, saying, "Sea tides destroy barriers and press upon the forbidden city. When calamities come, principle is not empty in their occurrence. Above one must fear Heaven's warning; below one must cultivate human affairs. Change calamity and summon harmony—it turns on Your Majesty's mind alone."

sentences.zh: ”又曰：“《周官》國有大事，則舉大詢之理。

translations.literal: He also said: 'In the Offices of Zhou, when the state has great affairs, the principle of grand consultation is employed.'
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "In the Offices of Zhou, when the state has great affairs, the principle of grand consultation is employed."

sentences.zh: 今日之事迫矣，謂宜合眾謀，屈君策，上而搢紳，下而芻蕘，各陳所見，擇其可用之策，以授任事之臣，庶幾千慮一得，以成天下人不因之意。

translations.literal: Today's affairs are urgent. One should combine many counsels and humble the ruler's plans—from gentry above to common folk below, each stating their views, selecting usable policies to entrust to officials charged with affairs. Perhaps from a thousand considerations one gain may come, fulfilling what people under Heaven do not presume.
translations.idiomatic: Today's affairs are urgent. One should combine many counsels and humble the ruler's plans—from gentry above to common folk below, each stating their views, selecting usable policies to entrust to officials charged with affairs. Perhaps from a thousand considerations one gain may come, fulfilling what people under Heaven do not presume.

sentences.zh: ”暫兼權右郎官。

translations.literal: He was temporarily given concurrent acting appointment as Right Department Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was temporarily given concurrent acting appointment as Right Department Secretary.

sentences.zh: 言：“財非天雨鬼輸，豈可輕施妄用。

translations.literal: He said: 'Wealth is not rained from Heaven or transported by ghosts—how can it be lightly spent and recklessly used?'
translations.idiomatic: He said, "Wealth is not rained from Heaven or transported by ghosts—how can it be lightly spent and recklessly used?"

sentences.zh: 長此不已，必至顛覆，異時或得罪。

translations.literal: If this continues without end, ruin must come, and in time one may offend.
translations.idiomatic: If this continues without end, ruin must come, and in time one may offend.

sentences.zh: 今之大夫不能為國生財，程異、皇甫鏄之徒乘間捷出，推敲克剝，以術相勝，鑿空取辦，以計巧取，事掊斂，獻羨餘，間架緡錢之令下，而唐祚愈促矣。

translations.literal: Today's grandees cannot generate wealth for the state. Men like Cheng Yi and Huangfu Bo seize the moment and emerge swiftly, squeezing and stripping by craft, competing in artifice, carving emptiness to obtain supplies, taking cleverly by scheme, practicing extortion and offering surplus tribute. When the house-frame cash order was issued, the Tang mandate grew ever shorter.
translations.idiomatic: Today's grandees cannot generate wealth for the state. Men like Cheng Yi and Huangfu Bo seize the moment and emerge swiftly, squeezing and stripping by craft, competing in artifice, carving emptiness to obtain supplies, taking cleverly by scheme, practicing extortion and offering surplus tribute. When the house-frame cash order was issued, the Tang mandate grew ever shorter.

sentences.zh: 願陛下精思熟慮，約已愛民，必如勾踐之臥薪嚐膽，必如衛文公之帛衣布冠，可也。

translations.literal: I wish Your Majesty would think deeply and consider carefully, restrain yourself and love the people—surely like Goujian sleeping on brushwood and tasting gall, surely like Duke Wen of Wei's silk clothes and cloth cap.
translations.idiomatic: I wish Your Majesty would think deeply and consider carefully, restrain yourself and love the people—surely like Goujian sleeping on brushwood and tasting gall, surely like Duke Wen of Wei's silk clothes and cloth cap.

sentences.zh: ”權吏部右侍郎，乞免兼檢正，從之。

translations.literal: He was given acting appointment as Vice Minister of the Right in Personnel, begged exemption from concurrent investigating duty, and was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He was given acting appointment as Vice Minister of the Right in Personnel, begged exemption from concurrent investigating duty, and was granted.

sentences.zh: 兼國史修撰。

translations.literal: He was concurrently Compiler of the National History.
translations.idiomatic: He was concurrently Compiler of the National History.

sentences.zh: 時邊事急，必願應詔言：“宜敕彭大雅自重慶領王青之兵東下以復夔，責李安民及歸、峽二守以自效，調一將督中流之師，以伐其順流之謀，調一將自間道出鼎、澧之後，以折其搗虛之鋒，調一將助芮興之勢，以備江陵之急。

translations.literal: When border affairs were urgent, Biyuan responded to the edict, saying: 'Peng Daya should be ordered from Chongqing to lead Wang Qing's troops east to recover Kui. Li Anmin and the prefects of Gui and Xia should be charged to prove themselves. One general should be dispatched to command midstream troops and thwart their downstream plan; one general from a hidden route behind Ding and Li to break their feint; one general to reinforce Rui Xing and prepare for Jiangling's crisis.'
translations.idiomatic: When border affairs were urgent, Biyuan responded to the edict, saying, "Peng Daya should be ordered from Chongqing to lead Wang Qing's troops east to recover Kui. Li Anmin and the prefects of Gui and Xia should be charged to prove themselves. One general should be dispatched to command midstream troops and thwart their downstream plan; one general from a hidden route behind Ding and Li to break their feint; one general to reinforce Rui Xing and prepare for Jiangling's crisis."

sentences.zh: 又宜下湖南遣飛軍及團結民兵之類守沅江、益陽江，以防衝突長沙，盡收江上民船，毋資敵用。

translations.literal: Hunan should also be ordered to send flying troops and organized militia to guard the Yuan and Yiyang rivers against a thrust at Changsha, and all civilian boats on the river should be seized so the enemy cannot use them.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan should also be ordered to send flying troops and organized militia to guard the Yuan and Yiyang rivers against a thrust at Changsha, and all civilian boats on the river should be seized so the enemy cannot use them.

sentences.zh: ”區畫皆中事機。

translations.literal: His plans all hit the mark of affairs.
translations.idiomatic: His plans all hit the mark of affairs.

sentences.zh: 暫兼權侍左侍郎。

translations.literal: He was temporarily given concurrent acting appointment as Vice Minister of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: He was temporarily given concurrent acting appointment as Vice Minister of the Left.

sentences.zh: 李宗勉每稱其平允。

translations.literal: Li Zongmian always praised his fairness.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zongmian always praised his fairness.

sentences.zh: 暫兼權戶部侍郎，兼同詳定敕令。

translations.literal: He was temporarily given concurrent acting appointment as Vice Minister of Revenue and concurrently joint reviewer of statutes.
translations.idiomatic: He was temporarily given concurrent acting appointment as Vice Minister of Revenue and concurrently joint reviewer of statutes.

sentences.zh: 請立國本，請親禱雨。

translations.literal: He requested establishment of the heir apparent and personal prayer for rain.
translations.idiomatic: He requested establishment of the heir apparent and personal prayer for rain.

sentences.zh: 遷戶部侍郎，暫兼給事中。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue with temporary concurrent appointment as Supervising Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue with temporary concurrent appointment as Supervising Secretary.

sentences.zh: 先是，錢相嚐繳陳洵益贈節使不行，必願復繳奏曰：“李韶向為殿中侍御史，疏論洵益，乞予外祠，以絕窺伺，陛下不行其言，復奪其職，韶不能自安，徑求外補。

translations.literal: Earlier, Chief Minister Qian had once rejected the posthumous grant of military commissioner to Chen Xunyi. Biyuan again rejected and memorialized, saying: 'Li Shao formerly served as Palace Censor and memorialized against Xunyi, begging an outside sinecure to end scheming. Your Majesty did not follow his words and again stripped his post. Shao could not feel secure and directly sought an outside appointment.'
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Chief Minister Qian had once rejected the posthumous grant of military commissioner to Chen Xunyi. Biyuan again rejected and memorialized, saying, "Li Shao formerly served as Palace Censor and memorialized against Xunyi, begging an outside sinecure to end scheming. Your Majesty did not follow his words and again stripped his post. Shao could not feel secure and directly sought an outside appointment."

sentences.zh: 今召之不至，正以此故。

translations.literal: Now he is summoned but does not come—precisely for this reason.
translations.idiomatic: Now he is summoned but does not come—precisely for this reason.

sentences.zh: 若超贈洵益，又繳駁不行，韶愈無來期矣。

translations.literal: If Xunyi is posthumously promoted beyond merit and the rejection is again not carried out, Shao will have even less prospect of coming.
translations.idiomatic: If Xunyi is posthumously promoted beyond merit and the rejection is again not carried out, Shao will have even less prospect of coming.

sentences.zh: 陛下忍於去一賢從官，而不忍於沮一已死之內侍，則何以興起治功，振揚國勢？

translations.literal: Your Majesty can bear to remove one worthy attendant official yet cannot bear to block one dead inner attendant—how then can governance be raised and national strength revived?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty can bear to remove one worthy attendant official yet cannot bear to block one dead inner attendant—how then can governance be raised and national strength revived?

sentences.zh: 欲望寢洵益節鉞，趣韶供職。

translations.literal: I wish that Xunyi's military honors be shelved and Shao be urged to take up his post.
translations.idiomatic: I wish that Xunyi's military honors be shelved and Shao be urged to take up his post.

sentences.zh: ”於是必願三以疾乞祠，不許。

translations.literal: Thereupon Biyuan three times begged a sinecure on grounds of illness and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Biyuan three times begged a sinecure on grounds of illness and was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 權戶部尚書，疏言：“端平元年，洛師輕出。

translations.literal: Acting Minister of Revenue, he memorialized, saying: 'In the first year of Duanping the Luoyang army was lightly sent out.'
translations.idiomatic: Acting Minister of Revenue, he memorialized, saying, "In the first year of Duanping the Luoyang army was lightly sent out."

sentences.zh: 明年，德安失，襄陽失。

translations.literal: The next year De'an was lost and Xiangyang was lost.
translations.idiomatic: The next year De'an was lost and Xiangyang was lost.

sentences.zh: 又明年，固始失，定遠失，六安失，郢、復、荊門失，蜀道蹂，成都破。

translations.literal: The year after that Gushi, Dingyuan, and Lu'an were lost; Ying, Fu, and Jingmen were lost; the Sichuan road was trampled and Chengdu fell.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that Gushi, Dingyuan, and Lu'an were lost; Ying, Fu, and Jingmen were lost; the Sichuan road was trampled and Chengdu fell.

sentences.zh: 又明年，夔、峽徙，浮光降。

translations.literal: The year after that Kui and Xia were abandoned and Fuguang surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that Kui and Xia were abandoned and Fuguang surrendered.

sentences.zh: 又明年，滁陽殲。

translations.literal: The year after that Chuyang was annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that Chuyang was annihilated.

sentences.zh: 越二年，壽春棄。

translations.literal: Two years later Shouchun was abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later Shouchun was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 明年，真陽擾，安豐危，成都遺燼，靡有孑遺。

translations.literal: The next year Zhenyang was disturbed, Anfeng was endangered, Chengdu left only embers, and not a survivor remained.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Zhenyang was disturbed, Anfeng was endangered, Chengdu was left in ashes, and not a survivor remained.

sentences.zh: ”又曰：“去冬安豐危而復安，特天幸爾。

translations.literal: He also said: 'Last winter Anfeng was endangered yet restored to safety—this was merely Heaven's favor.'
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Last winter Anfeng was endangered yet restored to safety—this was merely Heaven's favor."

sentences.zh: 君臣動色，太平自賀。

translations.literal: Ruler and ministers changed expression and congratulated themselves on peace.
translations.idiomatic: Ruler and ministers changed expression and congratulated themselves on peace.

sentences.zh: 雷作於雪宴之先期，蜀警於大宴之朌命，戒心一弛，赫鑒已隨之矣。

translations.literal: Thunder sounded before the snow banquet; Shu was alarmed at the order for the great feast. Once vigilance slackened, brilliant judgment had already followed.
translations.idiomatic: Thunder sounded before the snow banquet; Shu was alarmed at the order for the great feast. Once vigilance slackened, Heaven's judgment had already followed.

sentences.zh: ”又乞“諭太府丞，核戶部收支數目，庶見多寡盈虛之實，有餘則儲之以待朝廷之取撥，闕則助之以示宮府之一體。

translations.literal: He also begged that the Assistant Director of the Grand Treasury be instructed to verify the Ministry of Revenue's income and expenditure figures, so that the reality of surplus and deficit might be seen. If there is surplus, store it awaiting the court's allocation; if there is shortage, assist to show the unity of palace and government.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that the Assistant Director of the Grand Treasury be instructed to verify the Ministry of Revenue's income and expenditure figures, so that the reality of surplus and deficit might be seen. If there is surplus, store it awaiting the court's allocation; if there is shortage, assist to show the unity of palace and government.

sentences.zh: ”二疏迕丞相史嵩之，乞免官、乞祠，皆不許。

translations.literal: The two memorials offended Chief Councillor Shi Songzhi. He begged dismissal from office and begged a sinecure, but neither was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The two memorials offended Chief Councillor Shi Songzhi. He begged dismissal from office and begged a sinecure, but neither was granted.

sentences.zh: 以司諫鄭起潛論列，以寶謨閣直學士奉祠；

translations.literal: On the remonstrance of Supervising Remonstrator Zheng Qiqian he was granted a sinecure as Direct Attendant of the Baomo Pavilion;
