translations.idiomatic: On the remonstrance of Supervising Remonstrator Zheng Qiqian he was granted a sinecure as Direct Attendant of the Baomo Pavilion;

sentences.zh: 辭職名，不許。

translations.literal: he declined the title but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: he declined the title but was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 淳祐五年，以華文閣直學士知福州、福建安撫使，三辭，不許。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chunyou he was made Direct Attendant of the Huawen Pavilion, prefect of Fuzhou, and Pacification Commissioner of Fujian. He declined three times but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Chunyou reign (1245) he was made Direct Attendant of the Huawen Pavilion, prefect of Fuzhou, and Pacification Commissioner of Fujian. He declined three times but was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 閩人聞必願至，欣然歎羨。

translations.literal: When the people of Min heard Biyuan was coming, they rejoiced and sighed in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: When the people of Min heard Biyuan was coming, they rejoiced and sighed in admiration.

sentences.zh: 必願平易以近民，忠信以厚俗，惻怛以勤政，行鄉飲酒，旌退士，獎高年，裁僧寺實封之數。

translations.literal: Biyuan was plain and easy to approach the people, loyal and trustworthy to enrich customs, compassionate to work diligently at government, conducted village drinking ceremonies, honored retired scholars, rewarded the aged, and reduced the actual enfeoffments of Buddhist temples.
translations.idiomatic: Biyuan was plain and approachable to the people, loyal and trustworthy to enrich customs, compassionate in diligent governance, conducted village drinking ceremonies, honored retired scholars, rewarded the aged, and reduced the actual enfeoffments of Buddhist temples.

sentences.zh: 尤留意武事，甫入境，即以軍禮見戎帥，申明左翼軍節製事宜，措置海道修水，教士卒知勸。

translations.literal: He especially attended to military affairs. Upon first entering the territory he met the military commander with military rites, clarified matters of the Left Wing Army commission, arranged coastal routes and water repairs, and taught soldiers to know encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: He especially attended to military affairs. Upon first entering the territory he met the military commander with military rites, clarified matters of the Left Wing Army commission, arranged coastal routes and water repairs, and taught soldiers to know encouragement.

sentences.zh: ”居官四年，累乞歸，及命召，又三辭，皆不許。

translations.literal: He held office four years, repeatedly begged to return home, and when ordered summoned again declined three times—all without permission.
translations.idiomatic: He held office four years, repeatedly begged to return home, and when ordered summoned again declined three times—all without permission.

sentences.zh: 卒，遺表上，贈銀青光祿大夫。

translations.literal: He died. When his death memorial was submitted, he was posthumously granted the title of Grand Master of Splendid Brightness with Silver Seal.
translations.idiomatic: He died. When his death memorial was submitted, he was posthumously granted the title of Grand Master of Splendid Brightness with Silver Seal.

sentences.zh: 必願才周器博，心平量廣，而又蚤聞家庭忠孝之訓、師友正大之言，故所立卓然可稱雲。

translations.literal: Biyuan's talent was comprehensive and his capacity broad, his heart level and his measure wide. Moreover, from early on he heard the instruction of loyalty and filial piety in the family and the upright words of teachers and friends, so what he established was outstanding and praiseworthy.
translations.idiomatic: Biyuan's talent was comprehensive and his capacity broad, his heart level and his measure wide. Moreover, from early on he heard the instruction of loyalty and filial piety in the family and the upright words of teachers and friends, so what he established was outstanding and praiseworthy.

sentences.zh: 論曰：宋之公族，往往亦由科第顯用，各能以術業自見，汝談、汝讜、希錧是已。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Members of the Song imperial clan often also gained prominence through the examinations, each able to distinguish himself through learning and office—such were Rutan, Rudang, and Xiguan.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Members of the Song imperial clan often also gained prominence through the examinations, each able to distinguish himself through learning and office—such were Rutan, Rudang, and Xiguan.

sentences.zh: 彥呐帥邊而墮功，亦由廟算之短。

translations.literal: Yanne commanded the frontier yet lost merit—this too was due to short plans at court.
translations.idiomatic: Yanne commanded the frontier yet lost merit—this too was due to short plans at court.

sentences.zh: 善湘父子克平大盜。

translations.literal: Shanxiang and his sons succeeded in suppressing great bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxiang and his sons succeeded in suppressing great bandits.

sentences.zh: 與歡以長者稱。

translations.literal: Yuhuan was known as an elder of virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Yuhuan was known as an elder of virtue.

sentences.zh: 必願世濟其美，可謂信厚之公子矣。

translations.literal: Biyuan continued the family's excellence through the generations and may be called a son of the clan who was faithful and generous.
translations.idiomatic: Biyuan continued the family's excellence through the generations and may be called a son of the clan who was faithful and generous.
